messages:
Ben: Hey all, Ben here (first week). I'm blocked on onboarding: trying to run our partner smoke tests in ap-southeast-1 but get a 403 when opening the project IAM page for `partner-smoke-2026`. Need roles: project viewer + `iam.serviceAccountUser` on `smoke-ci-sa@partner-smoke-2026.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Also need billing.viewer on `redwood-apac-billing` to check costs. Who do I ping?

Sana: Welcome Ben! For GCP we need the project ID (you gave it) and your email. For billing we need the billing account id. Where are you seeing the 403 (IAM page or billing page)?

Ben: IAM -> Permissions page. Error: "You do not have permission to view IAM policies (403)". Email: ben@redwood.com. Billing account appears as `redwood-apac-billing` (id redacted).

Sana: Thanks. Quick checks to paste (redact anything sensitive):
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy partner-smoke-2026 --format=json

gcloud alpha resource-manager org-policies list --project=partner-smoke-2026 --format=json
```

Ben: Pasted (redacted): project IAM only has `group:partner-admins@redwood.com`. Org policy shows `constraints/restrictResourceLocations` = `[europe-west1]` on the folder.

Sana: Ok folder blocks APAC. Two options: temporary project-level exception to add `asia-southeast1` for a short window, or create a new project under an APAC-enabled folder. Which is faster for a one-off partner smoke run?

Ben: Temp exception is fine. Test window ~6 hours. Also need AWS assume-role `arn:aws:iam::888999000111:role/PartnerReadOnly` to fetch logs; `aws sts assume-role` gives AccessDenied now.

Sana: I'll open ticket CLOUD-8801 to request: add ben@redwood.com as `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` on the SA, add `roles/viewer` on the project, and request a 6h exception for `asia-southeast1`. I'll also ask cloud-security to add you to the `crossacct-readonly` group for the AWS role trust.

infra-bot: Ticket CLOUD-8801 created and assigned to infra. Temporary group `onboard-short` will be provisioned after approval. ETA ~4 hours. :robot_face:

Ben: Appreciate it. One small ask  when the APAC exception is applied will I be able to create a micro VM in asia-southeast1 or do I also need a quota bump?

Sana: Usually you can create a single small VM; quota bumps are only required for large or parallel runs. If you hit a quota error post-exception paste the exact CLI output and we'll request a bump. Also finance pre-approves up to $10 for short onboarding runs; tagging @cloud-finance.

cloud-finance: Confirmed  apac onboarding exception up to $10 approved. Any overage requires FIN ticket. :money_with_wings:

Sana: Update: added ben@redwood.com to `onboard-short` and granted `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` on `smoke-ci-sa@partner-smoke-2026.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Request for `asia-southeast1` exception submitted. Will post when exception is live.

Ben: Thanks! Will wait and then try `gcloud compute instances create smoke-test --zone=asia-southeast1-b --image-family=debian-11 --image-project=debian-cloud` once exception is live.

infra-bot: Exception applied: `asia-southeast1` allowed for project partner-smoke-2026 for 6 hours. Group `onboard-short` members updated.

Ben: Can create VM now and the smoke job ran. AWS assume-role still AccessDenied though. I'll paste the sts CLI output next if it persists. :thumbsup:
